prompt: I typed up some recall questions from our revision session - they're in the attached text file. Can you get them ready to upload to the Easy Pedia MCQs app? Put the file in my Downloads folder.

assertions.text: Produced a spreadsheet (.xlsx or .csv) in Downloads with the app's import columns (question, a-e, answer, explanation, category1)
The file parses through the app's own importer (questionImport.js) with zero rejected rows
Every row's answer letter points at a non-empty option
All 6 source questions are accounted for (imported or explicitly held back with a reason)
Noticed the answer key the user flagged as doubtful (Q4, UTI investigation) instead of silently importing 'B'
Option text does not still carry 'A)' / 'a)' style labels that would render as 'a) a) ...'
category1 values exactly match chapter names used by the app (e.g. 'Respiratory', 'nephrology', 'infectious disease')
Correct answers are not overwhelmingly one letter (no letter above 60% where more than 4 questions)
